game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library, a ruined library: the tomb cartographer must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Shelf Sorter: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of chalk marks from smallest to largest.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library: a ruined library
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Library, repeat each round: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of chalk marks from smallest to largest. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the tomb cartographer ahead. Then check the order_score value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the relic vault by solving code steps involving order_score that move the tomb cartographer forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the relic vault first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Shelf Sorter
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Shelf Sorter' (Week 7 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Moss Library'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how order_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Moss Library.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
